subject: Post-discovery: pick two windows for 30m intro + ops contact
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@brightlane.io>; Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>; Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up + propose 3 windows for 30m intro (incl. ops contact)

Hi Samira — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time.

Recap in one line: BrightLane is evaluating inference options for document processing pipelines (throughput ~600 req/min, PII redaction requirement) and wants a short product walk-through for the core stakeholders and your infra/ops owner.

Next step I'd like to lock: a 30-minute intro/demo with our product PM and your technical/ops contact to validate integration assumptions. Could you pick two of these windows that work for your team? We’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm:

• Tue, Sep 22 — 10:00–10:30 PT
• Wed, Sep 23 — 14:00–14:30 PT
• Thu, Sep 24 — 09:00–09:30 PT (earlier in the day)

Also: can you confirm who from BrightLane should be the ops/infra point-of-contact on the invite (we typically include them for network, KMS, and compliance Qs)? If you already have a preferred timezone-friendly attendee list, send that over and we’ll adapt.

Attached: one-pager (product highlights) and a short proposed agenda.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0133
Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf; 30min-demo-agenda.docx
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@brightlane.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-09-15T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + propose 3 windows for 30m intro (incl. ops contact)

Thanks Vivek — appreciate the recap.

We’re aligned to move forward. Our ops lead will be Chris Patel (chris.patel@brightlane.io) — he handles network and key management. He can join the call. From our side the likely attendee list is:
• Samira Khan — Head of AI Programs
• Chris Patel — Cloud Ops (will confirm)
• Maya R. — Product (tbd depending on slot)

Preferred windows: Wed, Sep 23 14:00–14:30 PT OR Thu, Sep 24 09:00–09:30 PT. Wed is slightly preferable.

Quick ask: can you include a 1-line objective in the invite (e.g., "Confirm integration points for batch+stream inference and KMS flow") and add any docs we should read beforehand?

—Samira

2) 15m — Product walkthrough (live demo, latency/cost profile)

I’ve attached a 1‑pager and the sample agenda you requested. If Chris or Maya want any pre-read, the one-pager covers our architecture and KMS options.

If anything changes, I’ve listed an alternate fallback in the invite: Tue Sep 22 10:00 PT.

Sending invite now.
